Method of Attack: dstr - plugin to overwriting device firmware files
ssler - plugin for intercepting and modifying web traffic on port 80 via man-in-the-middle attacks, supports downgrading HTTPS to HTTP
ps - plugin that can sniff network packets and detect certain types of network traffic, including Modbus TCP/IP packets and industrial equipment over TP-Link R600 VPNs
tor - plugin used by VPNFilter bots to communicate with a command and control server via the Tor network
Impacted Systems: routers and NAS devices from Linksys, MikroTik, Netgear, TP-Link, QNAP, ASUS, D-Link, Huawei, Ubiquiti, UPVEL, ZTE
Attack Vector: exploits against older firmware releases on vulnerable router and NAS device models
